title: L’esperienza Uni4Justice e le prospettive future
summary: This book contains the main results achieved by the Ca’ Foscari University Venice research group in the context of the Uni4justice Project financed by the Ministry of Justice, in which several universities of the North-East of Italy have participated, as well as all the Courts. The overall objective of the project was to support and implement, through research actions and training, the innovation introduced with the establishment of a new working unit in the Italian Judicial Offices. A broader reflection about Italian justice, useful to direct future policies, was a secondary aim of this project. This is motivated by the fact that the judicial system is being reformed in the context of the NPRR, where the main focus is on the reduction of the disposition time and the backlog.
